name: Dream Floor
description: 3/4 cozy US living-room flooring renovation. A couch tilts on a rotten floor; the player moves it, rips the rug, then a 3-tool combo (crowbar -> new planks -> finish) transforms the floor. Forgiving, no-fail, oddly-satisfying. Warm reveal + flooring-store CTA. Frame composed 3/4 (House Flipper / Design Home vibe).
